Name: MIXCRAFT_MAGIC_PARAM_ST
Description: Spells made from three collected elemental residues. The row ID is built from the three elements, so their order doesn't matter.

Fields.Name: Element 1
Fields.Description: One of the three elemental residues that make this cocktail (1 Magic, 2 Fire, 3 Lightning, 4 Holy). The order of the three does not matter: the combination is matched as a set.

Fields.Name: Element 2
Fields.Description: Second of the three elemental residues that make this cocktail (1 Magic, 2 Fire, 3 Lightning, 4 Holy); order does not matter.

Fields.Name: Element 3
Fields.Description: Third of the three elemental residues that make this cocktail (1 Magic, 2 Fire, 3 Lightning, 4 Holy); order does not matter.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Cocktail Spell
Fields.Description: Spell (Magic) cast when the collected residues match the three elements. −1: none.
